en: Dependent on a state that is not resultant, a state that is not resultant arises by way of root condition … pe … Dependent on a state that has the nature of not being resultant, a state that has the nature of not being resultant arises by way of root condition … pe … Dependent on a state that is neither resultant nor having the nature of being resultant,
a state that is neither resultant nor having the nature of being resultant arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)

With respect to the root condition (hetu), there are thirty-two; with respect to the object condition (ārammaṇa), twenty-seven; with respect to the predominance condition (adhipati), twenty-nine …pe… with respect to the mutuality condition (aññamañña), thirty …pe… with respect to the prenascence condition (purejāta), twenty-four; with respect to the repetition condition (āsevana), seventeen …pe… with respect to the result condition (vipāka), twenty-five …pe… with respect to the non-disappearance condition (avigata), thirty-two.
